{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Join compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Join docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697781'
Left Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Sort by molecule_chembl_id"
}
